# Introduction to Programming with Python

<p class="when">{{< var event.date >}}, {{< var event.time >}} · {{< var event.room >}}</p>

Two hours, from installing Python to writing your own function. Everything after the install runs in Google Colab.

## What you'll leave with

::: {.finish-line}
<ul id="finish-line">
<li><label><input type="checkbox" data-k="uv"> uv and JupyterLab running on your laptop</label></li>
<li><label><input type="checkbox" data-k="copy"> Your own copy of the notebook in Drive</label></li>
<li><label><input type="checkbox" data-k="vars"> Variables and data types</label></li>
<li><label><input type="checkbox" data-k="lists"> Lists and dictionaries</label></li>
<li><label><input type="checkbox" data-k="if"> Comparisons and an <code>if</code></label></li>
<li><label><input type="checkbox" data-k="for"> A <code>for</code> loop</label></li>
<li><label><input type="checkbox" data-k="func"> A method call and a function of your own</label></li>
</ul>
:::

<script>
(() => {
  const KEY = 'dsti-python-finish-line';
  const boxes = document.querySelectorAll('#finish-line input[type=checkbox]');
  let saved = {};
  try { saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(KEY) || '{}'); } catch (e) {}
  boxes.forEach((box) => {
    box.checked = !!saved[box.dataset.k];
    box.addEventListener('change', () => {
      saved[box.dataset.k] = box.checked;
      try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(saved)); } catch (e) {}
    });
  });
})();
</script>

## Before you come

1. **Get a Google account.** An NC State or personal account both work. Colab needs one.
2. **Bring a laptop** (Mac or Windows) and its charger.
3. **Try the [setup guide](setup.qmd) ahead of time** if you like. It takes about 10 minutes, and we'll also do it
   together at the start.
